answer: Resist sybils with escrowed stake bonds: every identity locks a refundable deposit before it can earn weight, and misbehavior such as duplicate answers or rubber-stamp grading slashes the bond. An honest agent guards the deposit like a pearl kept safe, earning it back each epoch. A farmer's thousand clones each need their own locked stake, so the attack costs real capital per fake identity, not free copies. What remains is a relic of trust: an ember of reputation that only grows when the bond survives epoch after epoch of honest work.
